name: Mummy is typing…
pitch: funny, too-real WhatsApp chats from an Indian family: Mummy who is always one step ahead, dry Papa, chaotic Nani, a Didi who snitches, and a broke twenty-something who gets caught every time
audience: Indians aged 16-35 (and their parents), scrolling fast, mostly on Android, many watching with sound off; they share reels to family and friends in DMs
